## Management performance


```{r} 
#| label: 'set-rda-dir-tbls'
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true
#| include: false

library("gt")
library("here")

# Function to read in lenght-1 .Rdata / .rda with name of choice
read_rdata <- function(path) {
    load(path)
    get(ls()[ls() != "path"])
}

port_tab_style <- function(tab, wd = NULL, font_size = "10pt") {
    out <- tab |>
        # reduce font size
        gt::tab_options(
            table.font.size = font_size,
            latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
            latex.header_repeat = TRUE
        ) |>
        # bold column labels
        gt::tab_style(
            style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
        )

    if (!is.null(wd)) {
        width_px <- 100 * wd / ncol(tab$`_data`)
        out <- rlang::inject(
            gt::cols_width(out, gt::everything() ~ gt::pct(!!width_px))
        )
    }

    out |>
        gt::as_latex()
}

``` 

```{r}
#| label: tbl-manage-guide
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Recent trend in the \\gls{ofl}, \\gls{abc}, \\gls{acl}, total landings, total mortality all in metric tons (mt)."

load(here("report", "tables", "exec_summ_tables", "recent_management.rda"))

recent_management$table |>

    mutate(across(-1, ~ format(round(., 0), big.mark = ","))) |>

    port_tab_style()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-compweight-comparison
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Comparison of key data weighting quantities from the August 2025 (Aug.) and the proposed base model (New). 'Lambda' is the likelihood multiplier applied in the August 2025 model (Lambda = 1 for all fleets in the new proposed base model). 'Weight x lambda' is the product of the estimated data weighting and the lambda. 'Sum N input' is the sum of the input sample sizes across all observations (which differs for BottomTrawl because discard data has been removed). 'Sum N adj.' is that sum after adjustment by the data weighting and lambda. 'CAAL' is conditional age-at-length data. Entries with --- indicate that fleet does not exist in the new proposed base model, and the composition data has been removed. "

# Read the table created in R/plots_bridging_supplemental.R
compweight_aug <- read.csv(here::here("report", "tables", "compweight_Aug2025_base.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
# add sum of input N
compweight_aug <- compweight_aug |> dplyr::mutate(`Sum N input` = `Mean N input` * `Obs.`)

# Read the table created in R/plots_bridging_supplemental.R
compweight_oct <- read.csv(here::here("report", "tables", "compweight_new_base.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
# add sum of input N
compweight_oct <- compweight_oct |> dplyr::mutate(`Sum N input` = `Mean N input` * `Obs.`)



# Join the two data weight tables for comparison
left_join(
    # only take a subset of the columns
    compweight_aug |>
        select(-Weight, -Obs., -(`Mean N input`:`Sum N adj.`)) |>
        rename(`Lambda (Aug.)` = Lambda),
    compweight_oct |>
        select(-Lambda, -`Weight x lambda`, -Obs., -(`Mean N input`:`Sum N adj.`)) |>
        rename(`Weight x lambda` = Weight),
    # other arguments to join
    suffix = c(" (Aug.)", " (New)"),
    by = c("Type", "Fleet")
) |>
    # rearrange columns for easier comparison
    # select(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 5, 7) |>
    select(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 6, 9, 5, 8) |>
    # format table using gt
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::sub_missing() |>
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "10pt") |>
    gt::cols_width(
        Fleet ~ px(110),
        `Lambda (Aug.)` ~ px(60),
        everything() ~ px(70)
    ) |>
    gt::as_latex()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-key-deriv-params

        columns = 2:4,
        rows = c(2:4, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17, 20),

        columns = 2:4,
        rows = 1,
        decimals = 1
    ) |>

        columns = 2:4,
        rows = c(5, 8, 9, 13:14, 18:19),
        decimals = 3
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
        table.font.size = 12,
        latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
        latex.header_repeat = TRUE
    ) |>
    gt::tab_style(
        style = list(
            gt::cell_text(style = "italic")
        ),
        locations = gt::cells_body(
            columns = "Reference Point",
            rows = dplyr::starts_with("Reference")
        )
    ) |>
    gt::sub_missing(
        columns = tidyselect::everything(),
        missing_text = "---"
    ) |>
    gt::as_latex()

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-proj-ofl
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Potential \\gls{ofl} (mt), \\gls{abc} (mt), \\gls{acl} (mt), the buffer between the \\gls{ofl} and \\gls{abc}, estimated spawning output (billions of eggs), and fraction of unfished spawning output with adopted \\gls{ofl} and \\gls{acl} and assumed catch for the first two years of the projection period. The predicted \\gls{ofl} is the calculated total catch determined by FSPR=50%. Catches in 2025 and 2026 are allocated using the percentage of landings for each fleet in 2019--2024."

table_g <- read_rdata(here::here("report", "tables", "exec_summ_tables", "projections.rda"))$table

# get buffers from forecast file
fcst <- r4ss::SS_readforecast(here(model_path, "forecast.ss"), verbose = FALSE)
buffers <- fcst$Flimitfraction_m

# which rows in the table are missing buffer and ABC values?
NA_rows <- is.na(table_g[["Buffer"]])

# fill in Buffer column from forecast file values
table_g[["Buffer"]][NA_rows] <- buffers[["fraction"]][match(table_g[["Year"]][NA_rows], buffers[["year"]])]

# fill in ABC as product of Buffer and OFL
table_g[NA_rows, "ABC (mt)"] <- table_g[["Buffer"]][NA_rows] * table_g$"OFL (mt)"[NA_rows]

table_g |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_number(
        columns = c(2:5, 7:8),
        decimals = 0
    ) |>
    gt::fmt_number(
        columns = 9,
        decimals = 2
    ) |>
    gt::fmt_number(
        columns = c(6, 10),
        decimals = 3
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
        table.font.size = 12,
        latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
        latex.header_repeat = TRUE
    ) |>
    gt::sub_missing(
        columns = tidyselect::everything(),
        missing_text = "---"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(
        align = "center"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_width(
        everything() ~ px(75)
    ) |>
    gt::as_latex()

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dec-table
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Summary table of 12-year projections beginning in 2025 for alternate states of nature based on the axis of uncertainty (a combination of M, h as described in the text). Catches applied to all states of nature are the projections from the base model using $P^* = 0.45$ and sigma = 0.5 with the time-varying buffer. Columns range over low, base, and high states of nature. Spawning output is in billions of eggs. OFL values for the years 2027 and beyond for each state of nature are the result of applying the harvest rate to the estimated biomass in that state of nature as discussed in Supplemental NWFSC-SWFSC Report 2 under PFMC Agenda Item G.3.a from September 2025."

table_h <- read.csv(here("data_derived", "decision_table", "dec_table_with_OFL_formatted2.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
table_h |>
    # replace with "-" all values in columns with names ending in "OFL" for the years 2025 and 2026
    # as there are adopted OFLs for those years
    mutate(across(ends_with("OFL"), ~ ifelse(Year %in% c(2025, 2026), "-", .))) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_options(
        table.font.size = 11, # reduced font size
        latex.use_longtable = TRUE
    ) |>
    gt::cols_width(everything() ~ px(50)) |>
    gt::as_latex()

```
